API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIApplication Segment ManagementShare the Application Segment to microtenants.
Share the Application Segment to microtenants.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/application/:applicationId/share

Share the Application Segment to microtenants.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

applicationId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Application Segment.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
shareToMicrotenants
int64[]
Responses
​
204
400
401
403
404
405
409
